answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 94 identities per epoch. Audits are published in trellis, queued in umber, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 105 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4323 identities would post 895 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
